selection_order: Retrospective follow-up after the previous axis-factorization analysis had examined these public data. This rule was recorded before the full 64-level source prediction run; it is not a blinded or prospective prediction.
data_ingestion: Existing hash-verified zero-simulated-duration files and reflection-derived representative quadrant; 21 complex axis records calibrate, 100 complex off-axis records are excluded from fitting.

preparation.calibration_rule: Equal-weight bounded nonlinear least squares on real and imaginary parts of the 21 axis records, with 33 fixed phase multistarts in one alias interval; original-axis stationary refinement at 80 decimal digits selects the final binary64 parameter point; thermal occupation >= 0. This remains a numerical fit, not a certified global optimum.
preparation.finite_thermal_rule: Capped geometric classical draw: (1-r)*r^n for n<d-1 and r^(d-1) at n=d-1, where r=nbar/(1+nbar). Every branch is retained.

coordinate_policy: Report both published extents without choosing by withheld agreement. Fit alpha in array coordinates; this does not identify the laboratory coordinate direction.

detector.operation: Source-compiled real displacement, number rotation, full finite-coordinate basis and smooth pointer dilation; p0 and p1 are norms of the resulting source-executed branches.

scoring: Descriptive RMSE over all 200 reserved real spin means and the corresponding binary probabilities; zero-response baseline; no significance or joint confidence claim for this point calibration.

numerical_replay_policy.revision_scope: Cross-platform replay repair after the original full source run; no new prospective or blinded comparison is claimed.
numerical_replay_policy.word_generation: Private 80-decimal-digit arithmetic from the original binary64 parameter ratios, including coordinate eigensystem and complete Gray/Walsh compilation; source pulse angles convert to binary64 at the existing compiler boundary.
numerical_replay_policy.contraction: Fixed chronological blocks through the unchanged native executor and polar guards; retain raw and corrected full products, both full-phase target checks, correction diagnostics, original complete word hashes and service counts.

error_accounting.occupation: Directed rational displaced-thermal moment and projected Duhamel bound for preparation and both coherent pointer arms, evaluated at exact binary parameter values.
error_accounting.numerical: Retain canonical source word hashes, raw and corrected full-phase target residuals, fixed block and final stabilization checks, accumulated correction diagnostics and probability mass residuals separately.
